outcomeNote: A baraita and an anecdote are recorded; nothing is contested, attacked or resolved within this unit.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא, הָיָה רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר: ״הוּא עָשְׂךָ וַיְכֹנְנֶךָ״ – כַּרְכָא דְּכוֹלָּה בֵּיהּ, מִמֶּנּוּ כֹּהֲנָיו, מִמֶּנּוּ נְבִיאָיו, מִמֶּנּוּ שָׂרָיו, מִמֶּנּוּ מְלָכָיו, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״מִמֶּנּוּ פִנָּה מִמֶּנּוּ יָתֵד וְגוֹ׳״.
segments.en: «It is taught» in a baraita: «Rabbi Meir would say» that the verse: «“Has He not made you, and established you?”» teaches that the Jewish people is «a city with everything in it. Out of it» come «its priests, out of it» come «its prophets, out of it» come «its chiefs, out of it» come «its kings, as it is stated: “Out of them shall come forth the cornerstone, out of them the stake,» out of them the battle bow, out of them every master together” (Zechariah 10:4).

segments.he: הָהוּא רוֹמָאָה דְּחַזְיֵיהּ לְהָהוּא גַּבְרָא דִּנְפַל מֵאִיגָּרָא לְאַרְעָא, פְּקַעיה כְּרֵסֵיהּ וּנְפוּק מַעְיָינֵיהּ, אַתְיֵיהּ לִבְרֵיהּ וְשַׁחְטֵיהּ קַמֵּיהּ
segments.en: The Gemara recounts an incident involving «a certain Roman who saw a certain man fall from the roof to the ground,» and «his stomach ruptured and his intestines emerged.» The Roman «brought» the man’s «son and slaughtered him before» his father’s eyes

segments.he: בַּאֲחוּזַּת עֵינַיִם, אִינְּגִיד וְאִיתְּנַח, עוּל (למעייניה) [מַעְיָינֵיהּ] וְחַיְּיטֵיהּ לִכְרֵסֵיהּ.
segments.en: «deceptively,» i.e., he only pretended to kill the son. The father «fainted and went limp.» By this movement, «his intestines entered» his stomach, and the Roman «sewed up his stomach,» and he recovered.

moves.summary: R' Meir expounds ״הוא עשך ויכוננך״: Israel is a city with everything in it — priests, prophets, chiefs and kings all from within.
moves.about: ״הוא עשך ויכוננך״ teaches that Israel is a city containing everything — its priests, prophets, chiefs and kings all come from within it
a baraita in which R' Meir expounds ״הוא עשך ויכוננך״ is adduced

moves.summary: Zechariah 10:4 is brought as proof that Israel's supports all issue from within it.
moves.about: prooftext that Israel's cornerstone, stake and battle bow all issue from within it

moves.summary: A Roman saw a man fall from a roof, his belly burst and his intestines out; he brought the man's son and slaughtered him before him.
moves.about: an incident in which a Roman staged a shock cure for a man whose belly had burst and whose intestines had emerged

moves.summary: The slaughter was an illusion; the father's shock drew his intestines back in, the Roman stitched his belly and he recovered.
moves.about: the Roman appeared to slaughter the son before his father's eyes, but only by an optical illusion (באחוזת עינים) — no killing took place
